test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight friends F1, F2, F3, F4, F5, F6, F7 and F8 are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center (not necessarily in the same order). F2 is not the neighbour of F1 or F8. Only F6 is between F2 and F5. F2 is second to the left of F7, F4 is second to the right of F3. Which of the following could be correct position of F1?

options.text: Third to the left of F5
Third to the left of F6
Second to the left of F7

solution:
According to the given information:

1) F2 is second to the left of F7.

2) Only F6 is between F2 and F5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89c19a3af0292c1f1608f54d58736672fe91a3d489223287cc147108e1971088.png] 

3) F4 is second to the right of F3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48a8d532e736e90587fdce35d29b95d605bf1431c035b63cdd25e031899858ad.png] 

4) F2 is not the neighbour of F1 or F8. Here case 2 gets eliminate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d538628ce357d60c4451afd2909ab726b52382bd42de87b71e291cf2b201dec.png] 

Thus the correct position of F1 can be "Third to the left of F6".

Hence, the correct answer is** "Third to the left of F6".**
